persona_summary: Sofie (52) from Hasselt runs an industrial cleaning company with 14 employees. Her business is growing, but about €280,000 sits idle in her current account.
diary_opener: Hey Sofie, I've already lived your next few months. Your business grew nicely, but the €280,000 in your account did nothing for me all that time.

cards.title: This month €280,000 in my account earned nothing
cards.body: I kept more than four months of salaries as a buffer. Safe, but in a term account the part above that would have earned me about €7,000 a year.

signals.label: Idle money
signals.detail: Since January about €280,000 more than your business needs each month has sat in your business account, at 0% interest

signals.label: New regular client
signals.detail: Genk Logistics Park NV paid its first invoice of €38,600 on 28 September

signals.label: Growing team
signals.detail: Your payroll rose 12% in 6 months, from 12 to 14 employees

actions.title: Put €200,000 in a KBC term account
actions.body: Keep €80,000 as a day-to-day buffer and lock the rest away for 6 or 12 months at a fixed rate. You'll see it right next to your current account.

actions.title: Your buffer covers 4.2 months of salaries
actions.body: Most businesses your size keep 2 to 3 months. See how your buffer moved this year.

cards.title: A week in, I noticed that only I could pay the salaries
cards.body: I'm the only director and the only one who can sign payments. If I'm out for months, my 14 people and my clients feel it right away.

signals.label: Sole signatory
signals.detail: The KBO lists you as the only director, and nobody else can approve payments on your business account

signals.label: Growing team
signals.detail: Your payroll rose 12% in 6 months, from 12 to 14 employees

actions.title: Key person insurance
actions.body: Pays out to your business if you can't work for a long time, so salaries and contracts just keep running.

cards.title: In December I had to hand in my three vans
cards.body: My Mercedes-Benz lease ended. I was already comparing electric vans, but chose too late and was briefly without a full fleet.

signals.label: Lease ends in December
signals.detail: You pay €1,980 a month to Mercedes-Benz Financial, for a 48-month lease since December 2022

signals.label: Quote for electric vans
signals.detail: This week you opened your KBC Autolease quote for 3 electric vans twice

signals.label: New regular client
signals.detail: Genk Logistics Park NV paid its first invoice of €38,600 on 28 September

actions.title: KBC Autolease for your 3 new vans
actions.body: Electric, with maintenance, tyres and insurance in one monthly price. Order before early November and they're on the road in December.

cards.title: Six months in, I was thinking about who takes over my business
cards.body: My retirement was still 5 to 10 years away, but starting now keeps more options open: selling, family or a management buy-out.

signals.label: Your question to Kate
signals.detail: You asked Kate: 'What happens to my business when I retire?'

signals.label: Pension savings maxed out
signals.detail: Your pension savings and VAPZ are both at the maximum for 2026, so there's no extra tax benefit left there this year

signals.label: Sole signatory
signals.detail: The KBO lists you as the only director, and nobody else can approve payments on your business account

actions.title: A first talk about succession
actions.body: One hour, no paperwork. A KBC private banker lays out your options and what you can already prepare: valuation, family, taxes.
